description: This file serves as the main entry point for a React-based web application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, CSS styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React application by creating a root and rendering the App component within React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render a React component tree into a DOM node.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the created root.
